svg.title: The SGMAP Procedure
svg.text: A good week for your region: the 10th-percentile turkey price
Frozen whole turkeys, ad week 7 Nov to 13 Nov 2026: 10th percentile of the regional average advertised price
10th percentile from PROC QUANTREG on season-adjusted log regional average prices, 2015-2026. Alaska and Hawaii are not modelled.
Data: USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Turkey Feature Activity. USDA reports eight regions, so every county in a region has the same value.
Generated using Jenner Analytics, a SAS-compatible statistical computing platform.
